left.text: All illustrations use one isometric projection. The projection is axonometric at 30 degrees, and the light comes from the upper left. Three faces are visible, shaded at 4, 9, and 15 percent. The whole family uses square corners. Marks are rendered as alpha masks so they take the surface color, and the only animated effect is a Bayer-dithered highlight sweep.
project(x, y, z) = \[(x - y) cos 30, (x + y) sin 30 - z]
